A1.justification: Both complete 19-page PDFs describe RealRAG, with corresponding Equations 1-10, Tables 1-5, Figures 1-13, and Appendices A-C. Text and visual inspection support a reliable comparison without material gaps.

before.justification: v2 reports original image-generation benchmarks, classification results, ablations, and a 26-participant human evaluation in Sections 4-5 and Appendix A.

after.justification: v3 retains the original image-generation benchmarks, classification results, ablations, and human-evaluation outcomes, including the appendix results.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1-3.3 retain the same reflective-negative selection, contrastive objective, CLIP-based retriever, and retrieval-conditioned generation procedure. No method component changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same database sources: ImageNet, Stanford Cars, Stanford Dogs, and Oxford Flowers. The three fine-grained evaluation benchmarks and novel-object test scenarios in Figure 5 are unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1, 2, and 4 retain OmniGen, Emu, SD V2.1, SD XL, SD V3, and Flux. Tables 3 and 5 retain Zero-RAG and Normal-RAG comparisons with Emu, SD V2.1, and Flux; the novel-object comparison also retains Flux.

E3.justification: The stated training/test split roles, ten generated images per class, FID/CLIP metrics, and OpenCLIP classification evaluation are unchanged. Both versions retain the same 26-participant study and task procedures in Appendix A.3.

E4.justification: Section 5 and Appendices A.2 and B retain the same retrieval ablations, checkpoint comparisons at epochs 2-10, t-SNE analyses, and qualitative examples. No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Figure 6 retains the same human-rating error bars and accompanying discussion of means and variance. No repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval, or significance-testing information is added or removed.

E6.justification: Tables 1-5, plotted results, and generated examples are unchanged. For example, Emu with RealRAG retains Stanford Cars FID 70.55 in Table 1, and Flux with RealRAG retains average classification accuracy 40.37 in Tables 2 and 4.

T1.justification: The problem formulation and Equations 1-10, including reflective-negative selection and the contrastive loss, are mathematically unchanged. Neither version adds distinct theoretical assumptions, theorems, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same novelty claim for real-object-based retrieval augmentation, benefits for fine-grained and novel-object generation, and compatibility across generator families.

C2.justification: Interpretations of reflective negatives, generation-space expansion, and human ratings are unchanged. Section 6 and Appendix C retain the same discussion of hallucinations, unseen objects, and applications, without new limitations or qualifications.

D1.justification: The CLIP/MLP implementation, frozen text encoder, ControlNet conditioning, database construction, and human-study details remain unchanged. The project-page access information is also retained.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning, and reference list are unchanged, including the application-related citations in Appendix C. No cited work is added or removed.

P1.justification: Affiliation 2 changes from Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Big Data Research Institute to Guangxi Key Laboratory of Digital Infrastructure, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Information Center. The version/date stamp is updated; body wording and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The longer affiliation produces limited first-page reflow, including shifts in the affiliation block and abstract, with small typesetting differences elsewhere. All five tables and thirteen figures retain their content, structure, captions, and placement.

improvement.justification: v3 updates institutional attribution and the version stamp, with minor typesetting adjustments. The scientific content, empirical evidence, interpretations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged throughout the main paper and appendices, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
